functions.name: JdbcConnectionString
functions.description: Gets the JDBC connection string for the SQL Server database.
functions.remarks:
Format: `jdbc:sqlserver://{host}:{port};trustServerCertificate=true;databaseName={database}`.
User and password credentials are not included in the JDBC connection string. Use the `Username` and `Password` connection properties to access credentials.

functions.name: Command
functions.description: Gets or sets the sqlcmd executable path inside the SQL Server container. Defaults to `Version18`, matching the integration's default SQL Server image.
functions.remarks:
Use a well-known path from `SqlServerReplCommand` or a custom executable path.
The executable is invoked directly, without shell interpretation, using the sqlcmd arguments.

The executable is invoked directly, without shell interpretation, using the sqlcmd arguments.

fields.name: DatabaseName

functions.name: AddSqlServer
functions.description: Adds a SQL Server resource to the application model. A container is used for local development.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the / container image.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name will be used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: The parameter used to provide the administrator password for the SQL Server resource. If `null` a random password will be generated.

fields.name: Port
fields.description: The host port for the SQL Server.

functions.name: WithCreationScript
functions.description: Defines the SQL script used to create the database.
functions.remarks:
Default script is
```
IF ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys.databases WHERE name = @DatabaseName ) ) CREATE DATABASE [<QUOTED_DATABASE_NAME%gt;];
```

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: The SQL script used to create the database.

functions.name: WithDataBindMount
functions.description: Adds a bind mount for the data folder to a SQL Server resource.
functions.remarks:
The container starts up as non-root and the `source` directory must be readable by the user that the container runs as.
https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/linux/sql-server-linux-docker-container-configure?view=sql-server-ver16&pivots=cs1-bash#mount-a-host-directory-as-data-volume

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source directory on the host to mount into the container.

fields.name: IsReadOnly
fields.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only mount.

functions.name: WithDataVolume
functions.description: Adds a named volume for the data folder to a SQL Server resource.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the volume. Defaults to an auto-generated name based on the application and resource names.

fields.name: IsReadOnly
fields.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only volume.

functions.name: WithHostPort
functions.description: Configures the host port that the SqlServer resource is exposed on instead of using randomly assigned port.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to bind on the host. If `null` is used random port will be assigned.

functions.name: WithPassword
functions.description: Configures the password that the SqlServer resource is used.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The parameter used to provide the password for the SqlServer resource.

functions.name: WithRepl
functions.description: Adds a REPL command that opens an authenticated SQL Server shell with the configured client tools.
functions.remarks:
This command is opt-in and available only in run mode. Dashboard users who can execute resource commands
can run commands as `sa`, including server-side operating system commands when enabled.
Enable it only for trusted dashboard users.
The default sqlcmd executable path matches the integration's default container image.
When using an older or custom image, select the executable path installed in that image.
The callback runs once during configuration in run mode, and the selected client is captured.

fields.name: Configure
fields.description: An optional callback to configure the SQL Server REPL.
